## SEO checklist
<!-- Delete what doesn't apply. -->
- [ ] New/changed pages export `generateMetadata` via `pageMetadata()`
- [ ] Title (~50–60 chars) and description (~120–160) written in every language
- [ ] New indexable pages added to `INDEXED_PATHS` (`lib/site.ts`) and linked from somewhere
- [ ] Changed or removed URLs have a permanent redirect in `next.config.ts`
- [ ] One `<h1>` per page; images have `alt`, size and are pre-optimised
- [ ] `npm run build` passes; `npm run seo:check` passes against a local build
